origin: Codex 0.142.5: the relay stops an answer with finish_reason content_filter after some text and a whole call: the answer is an interruption (a 502 that is not charged, the relay kept from the session), so the call is not given to the client to run before it sends the request again. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
